verdict.rationale: The evidence pack gives no TFLOPS or TOPS figures for any precision (FP64/FP32/TF32/BF16/FP16/FP8/INT8), and no sparsity qualification. It offers only memory capacity and bandwidth (141 GB, 4.8 TB/s) and relative marketing speedups such as '1.9X faster' and '110X faster'. Tensor-throughput specs are a core axis for a data-center GPU, so the absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can size training and inference from published tensor throughput — TFLOPS or TOPS with precision and sparsity stated, not a bare marketing number
